photos.definition: n a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material
photos.translation: n. 照片, 图片；相册（photo的复数形式）

photoscanner.translation: n. [医]光扫描器,摄影扫描器

photoscope.definition:
n. Anything employed for the observation of light or
   luminous effects.
photoscope.translation:
n. 透视镜荧光屏
[医] 透视镜(萤光屏)

photoscopic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to the photoscope or its uses.

photosculpture.definition:
n. A process in which, by means of a number of
   photographs simultaneously taken from different points of view on the
   same level, rough models of the figure or bust of a person or animal
   may be made with great expedition.

photosensitise.definition: v make (an organism or substance) sensitive to the influence of radiant energy and especially light

photosensitive.translation:
a. 感光性的, 对光敏感的
[医] 对光敏感的, 感光的

photosensitivity.definition: n. sensitivity to the action of radiant energy
photosensitivity.translation:
n. 光敏性
[化] 光敏感性

photosensitization.translation:
n. 光敏作用
[化] 光敏作用

photosensitize.definition: v make (an organism or substance) sensitive to the influence of radiant energy and especially light
photosensitize.translation:
n. [化]光敏剂
v. 使具有感光性, 使光敏

photosensitized.definition: v. make (an organism or substance) sensitive to the influence of radiant energy and especially light

photosensitizer.translation:
n. 光敏剂
[化] 光敏剂; 光学增感剂

photosensitizes.definition: v. make (an organism or substance) sensitive to the influence of radiant energy and especially light

photosensitizing.definition: v make (an organism or substance) sensitive to the influence of radiant energy and especially light

photosensor.translation: [计] 光电传感器; 光敏元件

photosetters.translation: (photosetter 的复数)  摄影排字机

photoshop.translation: n. 著名图象处理软件（美国Adobe公司）

photosphere.definition: n. the intensely luminous surface of a star (especially the sun)
photosphere.translation:
n. 光球, 发光球体
[电] 光球

photospheric.definition: a. Of or pertaining to the photosphere.

photostat.definition:
n. a photocopy made on a Photostat machine
n. a duplicating machine that makes quick positive or negative copies directly on the surface of prepared paper
v. make a copy by means of a Photostat device
photostat.translation:
n. 直接复印照片, 直接复印机
v. 复印照片

photostated.definition: v. make a copy by means of a Photostat device
photostated.translation:
n. 直接复印机；直接复印照片
v. 复印照片

photostating.definition: v. make a copy by means of a Photostat device
photostating.translation:
n. 直接复印机；直接复印照片
v. 复印照片

photostats.definition:

photostats.translation: n. 直接复印件, 直接复印机( photostat的名词复数 )

photostethoscope.translation: [医] 光波显音器(观察胎儿心搏用)

photostress.translation: 光测弹性应力分检用材料, 光应力

photoswitch.translation: 光控继电器, 光控开关

photosynthate.translation: n. [生化]光合物, 光合作用的产物

photosynthesis.definition: n. synthesis of compounds with the aid of radiant energy (especially in plants)
photosynthesis.translation:
n. 光合作用
[化] 光合作用

photosynthesize.translation:
[生化] vi.(植物等)进行光合作用,实行光能合成
vt.(通过)光合(作用)产生

photosynthesized.translation:
(photosynthesize 的过去分词) [生化] vi.(植物等)进行光合作用,实行光能合成
vt.(通过)光合(作用)产生

photosynthesizers.translation: (photosynthesizer 的复数)  [医]光合作用系统

photosynthesizes.translation: （植物等）进行光合作用, 实行光能合成, （通过）光合（作用）产生( photosynthesize的第三人称单数 )
